verdict: A very close rebuild of the Wikipedia Explore screen with every block, image and SF-style icon in place; the visible gaps are Inter standing in for SF Pro and the card drop shadows clipped to hard-edged rectangles, and the auto-layout structure with section/row components is well organised but has no shared styles and leans on spacer frames.

top_defects.where: all text (status bar, Today, section headers, card text, tab labels)
top_defects.what: Inter used instead of SF Pro: wider glyphs and different letterforms (e.g. 'Liste de sondages…' and 'On French Wikipedia' run longer, 'Community' wider in the segmented control); sizes and weights otherwise right

top_defects.where: Games card and Top read card
top_defects.what: the soft drop shadow around the white cards is clipped by the feed container: no shadow below/right of the card, and a grey square artifact shows outside the rounded bottom-right corner instead of the reference's diffuse shadow

top_defects.where: Top read #3 thumbnail (behind the tab bar)
top_defects.what: Star Academy logo shown whole and contained; the reference crops it aspect-fill so only 'tar / ader' fragments show

top_defects.where: Top read rows, rank circles and segmented control
top_defects.what: rank circle sits ~3 px lower than the reference, segmented control and labels 1-3 px off; text block extents differ due to the font
4 tab items are copy-pasted frames, not instances; no text/color styles or variables (styled: 0), colors and sizes repeated as raw values
fixed 'Spacer' frames used instead of padding/gap; row 2 title is a 488 px text in a 322 px frame relying on clipping rather than truncation; battery level text floats outside the Battery frame

top_defects.where: status bar, navigation bar, overlay chrome
top_defects.what: status bar and navigation bar children positioned absolutely rather than with auto-layout; tab 'Selection' rectangle 82 px wide inside a 76 px tab

strengths: Geometry matches almost to the pixel: header, banner, both section headers, cards, image thumbnails and the floating tab bar sit at the reference positions (grid cells mostly < 6 meanDiff outside text edges)

Status bar, W logo, nav pill icons, calendar, overflow dots and tab bar glyphs are real vectors closely matching the SF Symbols of the reference, with correct #3366cc link/rank colours and the selected Home capsule
Clean named hierarchy (Feed > Header / Section – Games / Section – Top read, Tab bar, Segmented control) with components for the section header, event row and top-read row
